subject: Shiny app was working but is no longer returning correct result, even though nothing changed

messages.author: c7cc0e9541f6875b
messages.subject: Shiny app was working but is no longer returning correct result, even though nothing changed
parts:
I am trying to create an app that will predict the next word based on a word that is entered. I had data from three sources, and created a corpus, tokenized it, and then created an ngram.

I want to stress that this was working perfectly fine before, it took a few seconds, returned the result "integer" for some reason, but then corrected itself and returned the result.

I submitted this as an assignment but it seemed to stop working, even though nothing changed, and now only returns "integer" no matter what is entered.

If anyone might know why I would really appreciate the help. This is very urgent.

Thanks!

Here are my server and ui codes.

server:

library(shiny)

library(rsconnect)

library(tm)

library(stringr)

library(data.table)

library(quanteda)

library(dplyr)

 

ngram <- readRDS("ngram.rds")


 

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

    homed <- (getwd())

    setwd(homed)

    wp<- reactive({

       

        y <- kwic(ngram, input)

        ydt <- as.data.table(y)

        ychar <- as.character(ydt)

        ydfm <- dfm(ychar, remove_punct=TRUE, remove_numbers=TRUE)

        w <- textstat_frequency(ydfm)

        wordPrediction <- w[[2,1]]

        wordPrediction

    })


    output$wordPrediction <- renderPrint({

        wp()

})

})


ui:


library(shiny)

 

 

shinyUI(fluidPage(

   

  titlePanel("Data Science Capstone: Word Prediction App"),

 

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

       textInput("text", label= h1("Enter Word"), value=" ")

    ),

    mainPanel(

        h3("Predicted Word"),

        textOutput("wordPrediction")

    )

)))
